summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a 6-K reporting the results of its 14 May 2026 Annual General Meeting. All 26 resolutions were passed, including routine items such as receiving accounts, re-electing directors, approving remuneration, appointing auditors, authorizing share allotments, and approving a final dividend. The filing is a standard post-meeting disclosure of poll results and does not announce any special situation event like an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other corporate action. It is a routine current report by a foreign private issuer.
